name: cam-parameters-extension-bit-all-additions-absent
reference: Values chosen; encoded as the PDU type CAM of the ASN.1 module CAM-PDU-Descriptions (ETSI EN 302 637-2 v1.4.1, forge.etsi.org cam_en302637_2 commit fed28cfe5c930dd9d3109ff1162c28008697754a) with ITS-Container (TS 102 894-2 v1.3.1, commit 2d2450e79aab4c7032ef615b72ddefaf2e5ba8a9) by two independent UPER codecs that agree byte for byte: asn1tools 0.169.0 (MIT, PyPI), codec uper, and pycrate 0.8.1 (LGPL, PyPI), to_uper. Input built by hand from vector 01: the CamParameters extension bit (bit 64) set to 1, and after the last root component the extension-addition bitmap: its length m = 1 as a normally small length (0, then m - 1 = 0 in 6 bits, ruling 16 of 0.19) and one presence bit 0; no open type. 330 bits. Accepted, nothing skipped (ruling 8 of 0.19). Expect: vector 01, the extension bit written 0. Checked against the pack's lines by a standalone reader and writer of them (Python standard library); derived without an engine.
